my-career.title: Career Navigator
my-career.purpose: Where can I go from here? Personal readiness for every next role, with gates and gaps.

my-career-roadmap.title: Career Roadmap
my-career-roadmap.purpose: A quarter-by-quarter plan to a target role, with what-if scenarios.

team-career.title: Team career plans
team-career.purpose: Shortlists and roadmaps that your team members chose to share with you.

nav.intro: Your personal map of next roles: how ready you are on the required competencies, which entry conditions you already meet, and what would close the gap. Indicative guidance only: ENEC and FANR decide eligibility.
nav.noRoleBody: The Career Navigator starts from your current job role. Your profile has none, so explore the career map instead.

since.none: Not yet qualified in this role

nav.notQualifiedYet: Not yet fully qualified in this role: months count from qualification
nav.readyNowSub: 85% or more on competencies and no unmet gate

map.title: Opportunity map
map.desc: Your role, the roles one step away and two steps away. Colour shows readiness; the line shows the kind of move. Select a role for its gates and gaps.
map.aria: Opportunity map: roles reachable from your current role
map.noneTitle: No published progression route starts from your role yet
map.noneBody: Look at the roles like yours below: they share most of your role's competencies and make good lateral moves.

gates.none: No published route into this role.

note.not_qualified_yet: counts once you are fully qualified ({n} months)
note.other_role: needs experience in another role ({n} months)
note.degree_role: your current role already requires it
note.degree_unknown: not on file in Kafa'a: your HR record decides
note.licensee: checked by the licensee outside Kafa'a (status only)

pathOnlyHint: Security, safeguards and cyber roles show the career path only: readiness and gate detail are not computed.

moves.title: Your next moves
moves.desc: Ranked by readiness, kind of move and distance. Readiness counts competencies only; gates are listed separately and never raise the %.

card.topGaps: Top gaps and how to close them
card.noGaps: No competency gaps: you meet every required level.

similar.title: Roles like mine
similar.desc: Roles that need a similar mix of competencies to your current role: lateral moves you might not have considered.

short.title: My shortlist
short.desc: Up to {n} target roles. Your shortlist drives your roadmap, learning suggestions and opportunity matches.
short.emptyBody: Shortlist a role from your next moves or from the roles like yours.
short.full: Your shortlist already holds three roles: remove one first.
short.share: Share my shortlist with my line manager
short.shareHint: Only people with you in their scope see it, and only while it is shared. You can stop sharing at any time.

detail.readinessNote: Readiness is weighted competency coverage (core 3, important 2, useful 1). Gates are shown separately.
detail.gates: Gates: entry routes and their conditions
detail.gatesNote: Each published route into the role, checked against your own records. Licensee checks stay pending: Kafa'a is a mirror, not an authority.

disclaimer: Indicative guidance from your Kafa'a records. Readiness and gates do not decide eligibility: ENEC qualifies staff and FANR certifies operators.

reasons.gates_met: Every condition on the route "{route}" is met in your records
reasons.gates_pending: Route "{route}": nothing blocks you; {n} condition(s) still to do or checked by the licensee
reasons.gates_not_met: Route "{route}": a gate is not met yet (about {months} months to go), so this role cannot be "ready now"
reasons.gates_none: No published entry route or gate for this role
reasons.band_ready_now: At least 85% of the required competencies and no unmet gate
reasons.band_ready_in: Indicative time to close the gaps and gates: about {months} months
reasons.band_stretch: A stretch: about {months} months of experience and development

rm.intro: Lay your route to a target role out quarter by quarter: programmes with their published durations, FANR milestones, experience you still need and development. Change the what-ifs and the timeline recomputes.
rm.targetHint: Your shortlist first, then every role your progression routes reach.
rm.name: Scenario name
rm.noRoute: No progression route from your role to this one
rm.noRouteBody: The published career map has no route between these roles yet. Use the Navigator's "roles like mine" to find a lateral first step.
rm.routeHint: Alternative routes, for example the graduate route straight to SRO.
rm.rotationHint: Taken before the first programme: it can push the intake back.
rm.result: In this scenario you reach the target on {date}.
rm.isEarliest: The earliest the gate conditions allow on this route
rm.beyond: This scenario runs beyond the {n}-year horizon; the timeline shows the first {n} years.
rm.timelineDesc: Quarter by quarter. The ringed blocks form the critical path; dashed blocks have indicative (SAMPLE) durations.
rm.exportNote: Durations marked indicative are SAMPLE values, not published figures. Kafa'a is not an authority: ENEC and FANR decide.
rm.sourcesDesc: Every duration shows where it comes from, or a SAMPLE tag when it is indicative.
rm.sendHint: Adds {n} development activities to your plan for this target (a draft plan is created if you have none). Sending again adds nothing twice.
rm.sendNone: Turn on mentoring, a rotation, the leadership course or gap courses to have something to send.
rm.confirmTitle: Send this roadmap to your development plan?
rm.confirmBody: {n} activities will be added to your development plan for {role}, as planned items. The change is recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS evidence ledger.
rm.savedDesc: Share a roadmap with your line manager for your next career conversation.
rm.disclaimer: Programme durations come from ENEC's published reports (SR2024, CNS) where available; exam and certification dates are indicative. FANR certifies operators; Kafa'a only mirrors.

team.intro: Career shortlists and roadmaps your team members chose to share with you, with their readiness. Use them in career conversations.
team.privacy: You see only what each person shares, and only while it is shared. Nothing here is used for selection decisions.
team.none: Nobody in your scope shares a career plan yet
team.noneBody: People share a shortlist or a roadmap from their Career Navigator.
